m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Yes, fool, there, with the Mouse!
Eek! A Mouse! It will contaminate our process!
You want to go deeper into Fort Rachias? Use the lever to open the gate!
Why didn't you just ask nicely?
Please, warriors, can you free us?
I was afraid you would leave us to our fate.
We could never do that! Be free, and buzz back to the Apiary. You will find it a changed place!
Thank you, kind Mouse, kind Spellbinder!
What other horrors will this place throw at us? Let's find out!
Now, what do we have here?
That chamber down the corridor is our goal, I bet! Push through those Black Bolts and make your way inside! I'll guard your back!
Battle through the Black Bolts and head for that chamber!
